verdict.rationale: Alacritty documents clicking URLs with the mouse, with configurable modifiers and opener program (alacritty-docs-7, alacritty-docs-29). It also documents regex hints that mark text for mouse or keyboard interaction without entering vi mode (alacritty-docs-13, alacritty-docs-36, alacritty-docs-3), which covers the keyboard-selection path. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence that file paths (not just URLs) are matched and opened, no detail on how keyboard hint selection launches the target, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
